courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering
courses.summary: The Students Traffic catalogue category for four-year undergraduate agricultural engineering degrees. Programmes in this category apply engineering to farming and food production: farm machinery and power, soil and water conservation, irrigation and drainage, post-harvest and processing engineering and renewable energy in agriculture, with field and workshop practice. Curriculum, regulator approval, admission route and fees are set by each awarding university, so the programme record should drive a shortlist decision.

Curriculum, regulator approval, admission route and fees are set by each awarding university, so the programme record should drive a shortlist decision.
